title: VoxSafeBench: Not Just What Is Said, but Who, How, and Where
reasoning: The paper introduces a benchmark for Speech Language Models (SLMs) that evaluates social alignment across safety, fairness, and privacy. Specifically, it includes an assessment of 'Exclusionary Norms' (normative harms) and 'Social Toxicity & Norm Violations,' which require models to make subjective value judgments on maturity, responsibility, and the normative acceptability of responses in social contexts.
